title: Web Server Monitoring - Meta-Env
readme:
This is a placeholder dashboard for web server monitoring.

Web Server Infrastructure:

**Server 60 (192.168.1.60) - Nginx**
- Role: Dashboard and monitoring services
- Port: 8060 (HTTP), 8443 (HTTPS)
- Services: Dashboard, Budget Control
- Recommended Dashboard ID: 12708 (Nginx Metrics)
- Exporter: 192.168.1.60:9113

**Server 61 (192.168.1.61) - Apache 2.4.65**
- Role: Production E-commerce (CRITICAL)
- Ports: 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS)
- PHP: 8.4.11 + FPM (256M memory, 32M uploads)
- Services:
  - okamih.cz (Czech e-commerce)
  - okamih.sk (Slovak e-commerce)
  - PrestaShop 7/8
  - Test environment (test.okamih.cz)
- Recommended Dashboard ID: 3894 (Apache Metrics)
- Exporter: 192.168.1.61:9117

**Server 62 (192.168.1.62) - Nginx 1.26.3**
- Role: Web hosting server
- Ports: 8062 (HTTP), 8462 (HTTPS)
- Services: TBD (awaiting configuration)
- Recommended Dashboard ID: 12708 (Nginx Metrics)
- Exporter: 192.168.1.62:9113

Import Instructions:

1. Nginx Dashboard:
   - Go to Dashboards > Import
   - Enter dashboard ID: 12708
   - Select Prometheus data source
   - Configure for Servers 60 and 62

2. Apache Dashboard:
   - Go to Dashboards > Import
   - Enter dashboard ID: 3894
   - Select Prometheus data source
   - Configure for Server 61

Key Metrics to Monitor:

**General (All Web Servers)**
- HTTP request rate
- Response time
- Status codes (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx)
- Active connections
- Bytes sent/received
- Uptime

**Apache Specific (Server 61)**
- Worker utilization
- Request per second
- CPU load
- Scoreboard status
- Virtual host statistics

**Nginx Specific (Servers 60, 62)**
- Active connections
- Waiting/Reading/Writing states
- Accepted/Handled connections
- Requests per second
- Upstream status

**Critical Monitoring (Server 61)**
Production e-commerce server requires:
- 99.9% uptime monitoring
- Real-time error detection
- Performance degradation alerts
- SSL certificate expiration warnings
- Payment gateway availability
- Database connection health

Security Considerations:

- All web server exporters on local network only
- Production services (80, 443) are public on Server 61
- Dashboard services (8060, 8443, 8062, 8462) are restricted
- Monitor for:
  - DDoS attacks (connection spikes)
  - SQL injection attempts (error patterns)
  - Brute force attempts (auth failures)
  - Suspicious user agents
  - Geographic anomalies

Exporter Setup:

**Nginx Exporter Installation:**
```bash
# Install on Servers 60 and 62
apt-get install prometheus-nginx-exporter
systemctl enable prometheus-nginx-exporter
systemctl start prometheus-nginx-exporter

# Configure Nginx to expose stub_status
# Add to nginx config:
location /nginx_status {
  stub_status on;
  access_log off;
  allow 127.0.0.1;
  deny all;
}
```

**Apache Exporter Installation:**
```bash
# Install on Server 61
apt-get install prometheus-apache-exporter
systemctl enable prometheus-apache-exporter
systemctl start prometheus-apache-exporter

# Configure Apache mod_status
# Add to apache config:
<Location "/server-status">
  SetHandler server-status
  Require ip 127.0.0.1
</Location>
```

References:
- SERVERS.md: /home/user/meta-env/SERVERS.md
- Prometheus Config: /home/user/meta-env/monitoring/prometheus/prometheus.yml
- Nginx Exporter: https://github.com/nginxinc/nginx-prometheus-exporter
- Apache Exporter: https://github.com/Lusitaniae/apache_exporter
